title: Patient-Provider Dispute Rights on Self-Pay Visit Package Charges
content:
**Notice.** A patient whose total billed charges for the services of a Self-Pay Visit Package exceed the Good Faith Estimate amount by the dispute threshold or more may start the federal patient-provider dispute process no later than the dispute window in calendar days after the date of the bill. While a dispute is open the disputed amount is not sent to collections. A smaller difference is not eligible for the process.

**Eligibility in one line.** The difference — total billed charges less the Good Faith Estimate amount — at or above the dispute threshold is eligible; below it, it is not.

**Examples on hypothetical figures (dispute threshold of $400.00, as on every tier)**

| Good Faith Estimate | Total billed charges | Difference | Eligible |
|---|---|---|---|
| $1236.00 | $1636.00 | $400.00 | Yes — equal to the threshold |
| $1236.00 | $1635.99 | $399.99 | No |
| $856.00 | $1400.00 | $544.00 | Yes |

**Effect of an open dispute.** For as long as the dispute is open, the disputed amount is not sent to collections.
